contracts.name: typed Portable Plan Mutation Port contract
contracts.evidence: PortablePlanMutationRequest validates operation, typed_target, correlation, contract_hash, idempotency, intent, preconditions, candidate digest

contracts.name: operation limited to accepted descriptors
contracts.evidence: only plan_init/plan_retirement allowed; external_plan_init etc rejected

contracts.name: Subject revision distinct from authority revision
contracts.evidence: subject_expected_revision int vs authority_source_revision opaque str|int separate fields; SUBJECT_REVISION_IS_EXTERNAL_AUTHORITY_CAS=no

contracts.name: authority revision distinct from normalized digest
contracts.evidence: authority_observed_raw_digest SHA vs normalized_plan_digest SHA separate; NORMALIZED_PLAN_DIGEST_IS_EXTERNAL_CAS_TOKEN=no

contracts.name: stale raw authority rejected
contracts.evidence: FakePlanAuthorityAdapter CAS fails closed on stale revision/digest; fixture not overwritten

contracts.name: invalid journal transition rejected
contracts.evidence: VERIFIED->APPLYING, CONFLICT->VERIFIED, FAILED_NO_EFFECT->APPLYING all rejected via is_valid_transition

contracts.name: apply-before-PREPARED forbidden
contracts.evidence: can_perform_external_attempt requires PREPARED durable then APPLYING durable; EXTERNAL_APPLY_BEFORE_PREPARED_ALLOWED=no

contracts.name: transport success alone not VERIFIED
contracts.evidence: PortablePlanMutationResponse.adapter_success does not imply VERIFIED; requires verify-after-write classification

contracts.name: observed candidate classification
contracts.evidence: classify_three_way candidate==observed -> VERIFIED_RECOVERED

contracts.name: observed original classification
contracts.evidence: observed==original -> RETRYABLE_NO_EFFECT (fresh auth required)

contracts.name: observed third state -> conflict
contracts.evidence: third state !=original !=candidate -> CONFLICT, heuristic merge denied

contracts.name: OUTCOME_UNKNOWN does not authorize retry
contracts.evidence: is_retry_allowed OUTCOME_UNKNOWN always false; UNKNOWN_OUTCOME_BLIND_LEASE_REUSE=no

contracts.name: RETRYABLE_NO_EFFECT requires fresh authorization
contracts.evidence: RETRYABLE requires fresh auth+Subject+raw+new lease; blind old lease reuse denied

contracts.name: same key + same complete M4-3 semantic identity stable
contracts.evidence: same complete fingerprint stable across request and journal record

contracts.name: same key + changed authorization identity not replay
contracts.evidence: changed principal/candidate changes complete identity -> CONFLICT, no replay

contracts.name: opaque journal/correlation ID is not semantic authority
contracts.evidence: OPAQUE_IDENTIFIER_SEMANTIC_AUTHORITY_COUNT=0; journal_id not driving authorization

contracts.name: J1-J10 all represented
contracts.evidence: CRASH_WINDOW_COUNT=10, all J1-J10 distinguishable

contracts.name: explicit J10 reconciliation mapping
contracts.evidence: J10 NONTERMINAL_AFTER_TERMINAL_PERSISTENCE_FAILURE -> RECONCILING explicit in model, state_machine, reconcile

contracts.name: no semantic rollback
contracts.evidence: SEMANTIC_ROLLBACK_ALLOWED=no, SEMANTIC_COMPENSATING_MUTATION_IMPLEMENTED=no

contracts.name: M4-6/M4-7 downstream interfaces type-check / compose
contracts.evidence: FakePlanAuthorityAdapter issubclass Port, JournalRecord composes with classify, M4_6/M4_7 flags true
